en: Black‑and‑white view over a small village in a hilly valley. Traditional gabled houses cluster along a road and a river, surrounded by fields, meadows, and dense forested hills typical of Central Europe. In the foreground is a larger guesthouse building with signage on the facade. At the bottom left, a printed caption reads "Luftkurort Huzenbach i. Murgtal". The overall style and wear suggest an older postcard photograph.
